steps.name: Plan & Refine
steps.prompt: Plan {key} ({url}) in worktree group {worktree}. Post a plan comment on {key}. Then run {done} --verdict done --note "<one line>".

steps.name: Review Plan
steps.prompt: Review the plan of {key} (round {round}). Notes so far: {notes}. Then run {done} --verdict pass or {done} --verdict gaps, with --note.

steps.name: Implement Plan Fixes
steps.prompt: Read the last review comment on {key} and close each gap. Then run {done} --verdict done --note "<one line>".

steps.name: Implement
steps.prompt: Implement {key} ({url}) in worktree group {worktree}. Then run {done} --verdict done --note "<one line>".

steps.name: Review Implementation
steps.prompt: Check the work in {worktree} against {key}. Then run {done} --verdict pass or {done} --verdict gaps, with --note.

steps.name: Implement Fixes
steps.prompt: Fix each gap of the last review comment on {key} in {worktree}. Then run {done} --verdict done --note "<one line>".
